correctness.rationale: Exact block identity M=H+rho(P^TP)^-1P^TQ and QR whitening similarity verified. Four independent cross-products converge jointly by multivariate CLT with finite second moment of entries (independent distinct columns), while P^TP->I. Real discriminant zero has Gaussian measure zero, giving p(t); divergent gap wins tight noise. Orthogonal Gaussian cone change yields specified integral, p(0) and large-t Laplace asymptotic. Rank(M-mu I)<=m-2<=1 for repeated Ritz m<=3 proves eigenvalues real. Four-dimensional SPD W=[I,eps J;-eps J,I] gives M=H+rho eps J, discriminant g²-4rho²eps². Own independent quadrature p(0)=0.292893218813452, p(1)=0.251972346913465, p(3)=0.077568320106147. Finite quadrature checks only integral normalization; asymptotic proof is CLT.
